the adapter's own candidate table (S18 + 6k, ReferenceId at +1) holds Stores this scan registered after checking their S0; Duplicate faults the earlier registrant of a NodeId through it

a Registry record slot (S58 + 6k) holds the ReferenceId of a Store the Catalog Store Directory Adapter registered after checking its S0 against GenericCatalogStore.v6 (DirRef); the Planner reserves the destination Store's capacity in its S27

network_provenance.device: the printer named by the request's PrinterRef, whose native stack the runtime programs (S0 job kind, S1 packed recipe and count) before switching it On
network_provenance.reason: S10 PrinterRef is posted by the Print Candidate Executor with the request (docs/ABI_REFERENCE.md); the target is a fabricator, not a program, so no contract accepts the write
S21 is the exact Runtime ReferenceId the Transform Job Driver posts with the request; Launch writes the Runtime's TransformType (S8) and request token (S16)

r9 is the Runtime's Admission (Runtime S17, the d1 ReferenceId it publishes at boot), and Admission S13 is the Transform Profile View ReferenceId it publishes once the view's identity check has passed; Readiness posts the TransformType request into the view's S70

S17 is the PressureTransfer ReferenceId of the request, posted by the Path Allocator and the Single-hop Builder; the Allocator pins its S99 kind tag, which both transfer runtimes publish, before staging the grant into S108..S120
Transfer S106 is the SourceReservationRef (docs/PRESSURE_GRID_CONTROLLER.md); Prep checks its identity through sp, and CommitRate adds the granted rate to its ReservedExportMoles (S12)
Transfer S107 is the SinkReservationRef (docs/PRESSURE_GRID_CONTROLLER.md); Prep checks its identity through sp, and CommitRate adds the granted rate to its ReservedImportMoles (S13)
S9 holds the Execution Bank ReferenceId this program stored in Reserve after checking its S0; Release reloads it to hand the reserved capacity back
